serverInfo.name: FlashAlpha
serverInfo.title: FlashAlpha Options Analytics
serverInfo.description: Real-time options analytics MCP for US equities & ETFs. 71 tools and 41 guided skills across gamma/delta/vanna/charm (GEX) dealer positioning, 0DTE flow, SVI vol surfaces, VRP, dispersion, skew/term structure, earnings, unusual options flow, strategy signals, multi-leg structures, a universe screener, and minute-resolution historical replay since 2018. Also exposes 9 strategy-focused persona endpoints under /mcp/{persona}.
